about.title: About Us

tips.title: Math Learning Tips
tips.intro: Master these tips to help children improve their mental math skills more effectively:
tips.tip1Desc: Begin with a small number range (1-10) for addition and subtraction. Build confidence before increasing difficulty.
tips.tip2Desc: 10-15 minutes of daily practice is more effective than occasional long sessions. Consistency is key.
tips.tip3Desc: Encourage children to understand the nature of operations rather than just memorizing formulas. For example, multiplication is repeated addition.
tips.tip4Desc: Comparison exercises help children develop number sense and understand relationships between numbers.
tips.tip5Desc: Master one operation before introducing the next. Suggested order: Addition → Subtraction → Multiplication → Division.
tips.tip6Desc: Give plenty of positive feedback. Focus on progress rather than mistakes to keep children motivated.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Math Practice ("this tool") takes your privacy very seriously. This privacy policy explains how we handle information.
privacy.collectDesc: This tool does not collect any personally identifiable information. All practice data (such as number range and operator selections) is stored only in your browser's local storage and is not uploaded to any server.
privacy.cookiesDesc: This tool uses browser local storage (localStorage) to save your practice configuration and language preferences. This data is not used for tracking or advertising purposes.
privacy.analyticsDesc: We use Google Analytics to collect anonymous usage data (such as page views and traffic sources) to help improve this tool. This data does not contain any personally identifiable information.
privacy.adsDesc: This tool may display ads provided by Google AdSense. Google may use cookies to serve personalized ads. You can manage your ad preferences in Google's Ad Settings.
privacy.linksDesc: This tool may contain links to external websites (such as the developer's homepage). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these sites.
privacy.changesDesc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.
